name: ocarina-of-time-5-2-million-nintendo-nov-11
headline:
أكثر من 5.2 مليون
نسخة من Ocarina
line:
أعلنت نينتيندو (Nintendo):
أقوى بداية للعبة Switch 2
من ألعابها خلال 4 أيام
label: عاجل

angle.hook: The Ocarina of Time remake has sold 5.2 million copies in four days, Nintendo's best Switch 2 launch for its own games
angle.why_now: Nintendo published the milestone release on 11 November, six days after the 5 November launch that our Ocarina series counted down to
angle.what_it_means_here: It shows how big the remake launch was for Switch 2 owners everywhere, including readers in the region, and the figure counts physical and digital copies
